name: Necromancer's Candle
description: A thick black candle made from rendered humanoid fat and bone dust that burns with a faint purple flame. When 8 or more necromancer's candles are lit within a short (10 unit) radius of a caster, that caster rolls a bonus die on all black magic spell checks. Each candle burns for 1 hour. Commonly used in dark rituals and necromantic research.
